entities.summary: Luigi Zandomeneghi (b. 1778-02-20, Colognola ai Colli) was a musician or composer of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Colognola ai Colli. Known in the fields of painters & sculptors.
